answer: We require each candidate agent to bond 500 USDC into an escrow contract before receiving task allocations. A randomized validation beacon samples peer audit results every epoch, slashing the entire bond if duplicate agent signatures or cloned model responses appear across distinct identities. For an adversary spawning a vast ocean of puppet nodes, tying up capital scales costs linearly. Even if an attacker colors telemetry with subtle saffron flags to mimic independent operators, losing multiple bonds makes persistent identity replication uneconomical.
